title: Tree iterator successor
summary: Recovered Game.exe 0x422e20 (79 bytes) as a genuine thiscall member: descend to the right subtree minimum or climb right-child ancestry; nonzero sentinel markers leave end iterators unchanged. Returns the iterator address and writes only its node pointer. Direct disassembly and callers at 0x42347d and 0x42a81e confirm layout and calling convention.
test_description: Direct i386 thiscall oracle comparison at original VA over every insertion permutation for sizes zero through seven and sentinel values 1, 2, 255. Independently expected sorted successors, repeated traversal, empty/singleton/end cases, immediate/deep right minima and parent climbs; byte snapshots verify all node prefixes, padding and payload remain unchanged, iterator guards and return address checked. Marked current node with null links verifies early return.
known_limits: Valid sentinel-terminated links required; null ordinary links and cyclic malformed trees are outside the original contract and are not tested.
Node payload type, full allocation size, and tree owner identity are unresolved; only the observed 16-byte prefix is modeled, with uninterpreted trailing bytes.
No full-game or all-input equivalence claim; no matching-byte credit claimed.
